basis: Hand derivation from the pinned grammar.js alone (the grammar.js the kind map pins) of the node type at the witness of each of the 76 differential-oracle alternatives of the r2 expected asset, written without reading the kind map, the expected types, the Roslyn kinds or any native output. A row states the class of the derivation, the derived types (the candidate set when the grammar text does not settle it), the node types of the same extent that the expected types may also list, and grammar quotes with their lines. A row of an external scanner token audits the type only: the grammar text does not give the extent of the token, which the position audit checks. The verifier recomputes the comparison with the ts of the r2 asset and the comparison with the ts before the ts corrections of r2 (initial). The audit covers the types only; the position of the witness is the position audit, and a derivation is what one reader derived from the grammar text, not a parser run.
